Now I have a clear understanding of the issue. The warning at line 2227 is raised whenever `padding=True` and `max_length is not None`, regardless of whether `truncation` is active. But when `truncation=True` (or another truncation strategy), `max_length` is used for truncation and is NOT ignored. The fix is to only raise the warning when `truncation` is not active (i.e., `truncation is False`).

transcript.content:
I've identified the issue. The warning at `src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py` line 2227 is raised whenever `padding=True` and `max_length` is set, regardless of whether `truncation` is also active. But when `truncation=True`, `max_length` IS used for truncation (not ignored), so the warning is incorrect.

The fix is to modify the condition on line 2226 to only warn when `truncation` is not active (i.e., `truncation is False`), because in that case `max_length` has no effect.
